linux.renderer: Ubuntu 24.04, Godot 4.6.3, llvmpipe, software OpenGL. Four sizes, 1280x800, native resolution, 4x MSAA, shadows. Short 20 rendered frames per size; movie fixed-time data are not used for performance.

macos.environment: GitHub-hosted Apple Silicon; each application process tested with empty Godot data, system and GPU caches retained. Virtual GPU may report no nonzero GPU timestamps.
macos.cold_scope: New application process and empty Godot data directory per launch; no driver cache removal or full host reboot.

treatment.change: Configure the root 4x-MSAA framebuffer before creating terrain and soldier resources. Saved quality still applies during setup and is freely adjustable afterwards. Sample the main process before and after scene construction; count shader-pipeline milestones without presuming the first frame exists.

rc20_focus_control.window_helper: Foreground helper saw the game's app inactive during interruption; then reactivated it. No Godot window_focus_out event or pause was observed by the game. The same process was advancing at tick 173 by timeout.

profile.conclusion: Longest frame fell two frames after camera moved, without a simulation tick; no GPU timestamps available to attribute the remaining wall time.
